title: 緋色の蒸気と、砕け散る万華鏡の貌
author: 硝子 シオン

en.title: Scarlet Steam and the Shattering Kaleidoscope Visage
en.premise: The steam engine, the very heart of the city, burns fueled by the "memories" of the beautiful. As a mirror craftsman, I one day encounter a "peeled-away self"—a being both beautiful and hideous, peering at me from beyond the glass. It is a crystal of the soul, melted by the searing heat of the steam. To preserve beauty for eternity, I step into a forbidden ritual to transform my own flesh into glass.

zh.title: 绯色蒸汽与破碎万花筒的面容
zh.premise: 作为城市心脏的蒸汽机，正以美丽之人的“记忆”为燃料燃烧着。身为镜匠的我，某日遇见了从镜子另一侧窥视着此方的、既美丽又令人毛骨悚然的“剥离之自我”。那是被蒸汽的热量所融化的、灵魂的结晶。为了将美永恒留存，我踏入了将肉身化为玻璃的禁忌仪式。
